grid-min-item-sm.$description: Narrowest an item gets in a Grid with minItemWidth="sm" before the grid drops a column: small tiles, stat cards, swatches.

grid-min-item-md.$description: Narrowest an item gets in a Grid with minItemWidth="md": content cards with a title and a line or two of text.

grid-min-item-lg.$description: Narrowest an item gets in a Grid with minItemWidth="lg": cards with media or a form. Matches a narrow phone, so one column still fits.
